dataset_sources.name: Naukri 30K General Jobs
dataset_sources.note: Skills extracted from Key Skills column, not full job description

salary.note: Only disclosed salaries are used for salary statistics unless explicitly labeled as estimated

company.note: Dataset 1 lacks a company column; those rows are marked Unknown

limitations: Dataset 1 is from July–August 2019 — salary benchmarks may not reflect current market rates.
Dataset 2 has no date column — temporal trend analysis is not possible with this data.
231 of 5347 jobs (4.3%) have unknown company names.
Only 33 of 5347 jobs (0.6%) have disclosed salary information.
Salary parsing uses regex on unstructured text — some salaries may be misread or missed.
Skill extraction uses keyword matching, not contextual NLP — accuracy ~90-95% for known DA/DS tools.
Company tier classification uses substring matching against curated lists — unlisted companies default to Startup/Other.

methodology.salary_parsing: Regex extraction from salary_text field. Patterns: X-Y LPA (midpoint), X LPA (direct), Indian format X,XX,XXX PA (converted to LPA), Rs/INR/₹ prefix (converted).
methodology.skill_extraction: Vocabulary-based entity matching with 40+ canonical skills and 200+ keyword variants. Each job description is lowercased and checked for keyword presence.
methodology.company_tiering: Substring match against curated lists: 43 Product companies, 19 Consulting firms, 21 MNC/IT Services. Default: Startup/Other.
methodology.experience_parsing: Regex extraction of X-Y, X+, or single number patterns from experience text field.

enrichment.note: Estimated salaries are model-generated and should never be presented as observed data.
